faqs.question: How long does it take to develop a complete mobile MVP?
faqs.answer: Most MVPs with 6–12 core screens, user authentication, core workflow logic, and API integrations take between 4 to 8 weeks. We break the project into clear weekly milestones, so you can test working builds on your phone from week 2.

faqs.question: Can you handle the entire Apple App Store and Google Play launch process?
faqs.answer: Yes, 100%! Store deployment is one of the biggest friction points for founders. I handle Apple Developer & Google Play Console setup, iOS certificates, provisioning profiles, privacy manifests, data safety questionnaires, screenshot prep, and coordinate with review teams until the app is live.

faqs.question: How do we work together (Pricing & Payment Structure)?
faqs.answer: I offer two flexible models: Fixed-Price Milestones for well-scoped MVPs and defined deliverables (providing total budget predictability), or Weekly / Monthly Sprints for evolving products where scope shifts dynamically as user feedback comes in.

faqs.question: I already have Figma designs and a backend team. Can you work with them?
faqs.answer: Yes, absolutely! I regularly collaborate with design and backend teams. I convert Figma designs into pixel-perfect, responsive React Native screens and integrate with your existing REST, GraphQL, or Firebase backend seamlessly.

faqs.question: What happens after the app is launched? Do you offer support?
faqs.answer: Every completed project comes with 30 days of complimentary post-launch bug fixing and support to ensure a rock-solid release. After that, I offer flexible monthly maintenance retainers for OS compatibility updates, new features, and performance monitoring.

faqs.question: Why choose React Native over native Swift/Kotlin?
faqs.answer: React Native allows us to write a single TypeScript codebase that compiles into genuine native UI for both iOS and Android. This cuts your development and maintenance costs by almost 50% while getting your product into users' hands in half the time, with 60 FPS performance.
